purpose: Existing green player disappointment reaction after losing a competition sprint
sourceHandling: Final generated PNG bytes and alpha preserved. Runtime metadata aligns the feet, body scale and atlas cells without image post-processing.
notes: The existing player is the identity/costume reference; the yellow boss is unchanged.
Voxel top was regenerated to correct an oblique candidate to the existing horizontal overhead camera. The discarded candidate remains outside the repository.
Eight frames: rest, lowered shoulders/head, leaning, hands on knees, deeper bow, forehead gesture, recovery, subdued near-upright rest.

Reference image is identity, uniform, anatomy, camera and rendering-style guide only. Same short dark curly/wavy hair, warm tan skin, lean muscular mature athlete, forest-green unbranded singlet and dark forest-green fitted running shorts, cream/off-white sprint shoes, SAME identity and costume in every cell. This is an understated disappointment / frustration reaction after losing a sprint, never a victorious gesture. No raised celebratory fists, jumping, laughing or injury. Emotion is readable through head, shoulders, torso and arms. Feet remain planted in the exact same position through all frames, body pixel scale and camera fixed, no drifting. A graceful 2.4-second sequence that returns toward the original resting stance.

Keep each figure at the SAME scale even as the torso bends; do not enlarge bent poses to fill the cell.
